description.text:
The first cards of the XY Series, released on 8 November 2013. The Kalos Starter Set is three theme decks built around the Kalos first partner Pokémon, Chespin, Fennekin and Froakie, each with a rule book, counters, a coin, a deck box and a code that unlocks the deck in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Online. Deluxe versions added a booster pack from the Black & White Series.

Its 39 cards, numbered 1/39 to 39/39, hold the three evolution lines with the Pokémon and Trainer cards around them. The set also brought a lasting rule change: from here on, the player who goes first cannot attack on the first turn. Its Japanese counterparts, the Beginning Set and the Beginning Set for Girls, came out on the same day.
